description: PHP class for handling PDF output using the PDFlib extension, including methods for creating PDF documents, drawing shapes, adding text and images, and exporting the result.

classes.name: Image_Canvas_PDF
classes.description: A class extending Image_Canvas for generating PDF output using PDFlib, supporting drawing shapes, text, images, and exporting PDF files.

methods.name: Image_Canvas_PDF
methods.description: Constructor initializing PDF page size, orientation, and PDFlib resource.

methods.name: _getX
methods.description: Converts relative x-coordinate to absolute position based on left offset.

methods.name: _getY
methods.description: Converts relative y-coordinate to absolute position based on page height and top offset.

methods.name: _color
methods.description: Converts color input to normalized RGB array for PDFlib.

methods.name: _setLineStyle
methods.description: Sets the line style and width in the PDF context.

methods.name: _setFillStyle
methods.description: Sets the fill style color in the PDF context.

methods.name: _setFont
methods.description: Sets the font for text rendering in the PDF.

methods.name: _reset
methods.description: Resets the graphics state of the PDF canvas.

methods.name: line
methods.description: Draws a line between two points with optional color.

methods.name: polygon
methods.description: Draws a polygon with optional fill and stroke colors.

methods.name: rectangle
methods.description: Draws a rectangle with optional fill and stroke.

methods.name: ellipse
methods.description: Draws an ellipse or circle with optional fill and stroke.

methods.name: pieslice
methods.description: Draws a pie slice; not yet implemented in PDF.

methods.name: textWidth
methods.description: Calculates width of text in current font.

methods.name: textHeight
methods.description: Returns height of text based on font size.

methods.name: addText
methods.description: Adds text at specified position with alignment and color.

methods.name: image
methods.description: Overlays an image at specified position with optional resizing and alignment.

methods.name: show
methods.description: Outputs the generated PDF to browser and closes resources.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the generated PDF to a file.

methods.name: toHtml
methods.description: Returns an HTML link to the generated PDF file.

methods.name: _version
methods.description: Detects the major version of PDFlib installed.
